integrity: The analytic proof covers every eligible integer size and positive rate; exact finite-state and spectral tests are independent corroboration, not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: Finite complete bipartite networks with m,n >= 2; two independent walkers, exponential class-dependent total jump rates, stopping at first collision. No arbitrary-graph or multiwalker classification; no independent validation.
title: Mobility-controlled reversal of encounter hazards on complete bipartite networks
